name: Reference sheet (large, tables)
angle: A reader who wants a compact reference with tables and short sections.
intent_summary: Large brand-subpage written as a reference sheet about the Longfu88 mobile casino in Singapore: the shortcut for Android and iOS, the features in a table, the shortcut versus the browser tab, registration, withdrawals, protection, technical data, the sportsbook, game categories, deposit methods, currencies and languages, fixes, support and a FAQ; no device section and no login section (the registration section carries both).
